d:
Hey everyone! I’m IndigoWings, and I’ve just published my first comic, Element of Darkness. It’s the start of a new corruption-themed series I’m really excited about.

Disclaimer: This comic is only suitable for adults only.

I’m planning to release more chapters throughout the year, though the schedule isn’t fully set yet.

I’d love to hear your thoughts. Comments, critiques, and suggestions are all welcome. Thanks so much for checking it out!
